div.head: II Cn 20a
div.ab: Si he heorðfæst, si he folgere, þæt ælc si on hundrede ⁊ on borge gebroht, ⁊ gehealde se borh híne ⁊ gelæde to ælcan rihte.
Sy he heorþfæst, sy he folgere, þæt ælc sy on hundrede ⁊ on borge gebroht, ⁊ gehealde se borh hine ⁊ læde to ælce rihte.
Sit heorðfest, sit folgarius: sit in hundreto et plegio constitutus, et teneat eum plegius et adducat ad omne rectum.
sy he heorðfæst, sy hé folgere—þæt ælc sy on hundre[d] ⁊ on borh gebroht ⁊ gehealde se borh híne ⁊ gelæde to ælcon gerihte.

whether he has an establishment of his own or is in the service of another—everyone shall be brought within a hundred and under surety, and his surety shall hold and bring him to the performance of every legal duty.
Whether he has a home of his own, or is in the following of another, each is to be brought into a hundred and under surety, and the surety is to hold him and bring him to every legal duty.

Sei er hausangesessen, sei er [Miteinwohner vom Haushalts]gefolge: jeder werde in Hundertschaft und in Bürgschaft gebracht; und dieser Bürge[nverband?] halte ihn [in Aufsicht] und stelle ihn zu jeder Rechtspflicht.
Whether he be a householder or a [household] follower: let each be brought into a hundred and under surety, and let the surety keep him and bring him to every legal obligation.
